columns.name: Alert ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for each alert

columns.name: Topic
columns.description: A general designation of the alert.  Alerts contain only one topic.

columns.name: Category Name
columns.description: Designates general areas to which the alert has a relationship.  This closely aligns to the pages in the HAN in which the alert or topic information will appear.  There  can be one or many categories per one alert. Therefore, it generally will be best to use the "Contains" operator when filtering for records matching a category.

columns.name: Priority
columns.description: Priority is generally meant to convey the immediacy of attention that should be assigned to the alert topic.   Levels are Urgent, High (default), Medium and Low.

columns.name: Abstract
columns.description: A short summary of the alert.

columns.name: Full Details HTML
columns.description: The full alert, formatted in HTML.

columns.name: Full Details Markdown
columns.description: The full alert, formatted in markdown.

columns.name: Has Attachment
columns.description: Whether the alert has one or more attachments. If Yes, please visit the HAN site to see the attachment(s).

columns.name: Alert URL
columns.description: Link to the alert on the HAN site.
